title: Harness of Minervini v2 clock response

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

limitations: Future dates, weekends, exchange holidays, and known special exchange closures are rejected.
The calendar models regular and standard early closes; it is not an intraday trading clock.
x-capability-contract.output: The latest completed US regular session, or the validated explicit completed session.

status_meanings.needs_input: The date is malformed or is not a completed US trading session.
status_meanings.ok: A completed session boundary was resolved.

x-capability-contract.summary: Resolve the point-in-time boundary shared by every analytical capability.
